title: Subsea Inspection and Pipeline Integrity Assessment — North West Shelf
description: Provision of ROV-based subsea inspection services and pipeline integrity assessment for offshore gas infrastructure in the Carnarvon Basin. Scope includes external visual inspection, cathodic protection survey, and integrity reporting. Western Australia.

title: ROV Inspection Services Framework — Browse Basin LNG Assets
description: Multi-year framework agreement for work-class ROV inspection services across LNG production assets in the Browse Basin. Annual call-off value estimated $2M–$5M. Vendors must demonstrate Perth-based mobilisation capability.

title: Offshore Pipeline NDT and Integrity Reporting — Timor Sea
description: Non-destructive testing and pipeline integrity reporting for ageing offshore petroleum infrastructure in the Timor Sea. Includes phased array UT, ACFM, and integrity dashboard delivery.

title: Subsea Repair and Cathodic Protection Retrofit — Pilbara Region
description: Subsea repair scope including clamp installation, anode retrofit, and post-repair inspection for an offshore loading facility in the Pilbara. Vessel and ROV spread to be provided by vendor.

title: Underwater Inspection of Port Infrastructure — Fremantle
description: Underwater inspection of port piling, wharf substructures, and submerged assets at Fremantle Port. Diving and ROV combination acceptable. Reporting to Australian Standard AS 3962.

title: FPSO Mooring and Riser Inspection Campaign
description: Inspection campaign for FPSO mooring chains, riser systems, and turret swivel assembly. Combination of class-driven and integrity-driven scope. Mobilisation ex Perth preferred.

title: Hydrographic Survey Services — Coastal Queensland
description: Hydrographic survey of coastal shipping channels in Queensland. Single-beam and multi-beam echo sounding required. Pure survey scope; no inspection or integrity component.

title: Offshore Wind Foundation Inspection — Bass Strait Pilot
description: Inspection of foundation structures and scour monitoring for offshore wind pilot project. Subsea inspection capability essential; ROV preferred over diver-based methods.

title: Vessel Hull Cleaning Services — Multiple WA Ports
description: In-water hull cleaning services for commercial vessels at multiple WA port locations. Cleaning services only — no inspection or NDT component required.

title: Subsea Cable Route Survey and Post-Lay Inspection — Tasmania Link
description: Pre-installation route survey and post-lay inspection for a 200km subsea telecommunications cable between mainland Australia and Tasmania. ROV and AUV capability required.

title: Catering Services — Offshore Accommodation Vessel
description: Provision of catering services for offshore accommodation vessel supporting subsea construction campaign. 24/7 galley operation for 80-pax crew. Catering only.

title: Wellhead Integrity Assessment — Producing Gas Field
description: Wellhead and Christmas tree integrity assessment programme across 12 producing subsea wells. Scope includes ROV inspection, cathodic protection survey, and integrity engineering report.

title: Office Furniture Supply — Regional Government Offices
description: Supply and installation of office furniture for newly refurbished regional government offices. Three-year framework agreement.

title: Marine NDT Services Panel — Offshore Energy Assets
description: Establishment of approved panel of marine NDT service providers for member companies' offshore energy assets. Includes phased array, ACFM, eddy current, and visual inspection methods.

title: Diving Services — Port Inspection and Light Repair
description: Provision of commercial diving services for routine port inspection and light underwater repair work at Dampier and Port Hedland. ADAS Part 3 certified divers required.

title: Software Development — Asset Management Platform
description: Development of cloud-hosted asset management platform with mobile data capture. Three-year build and support engagement.

title: Cathodic Protection Survey — Onshore Pipeline Network
description: Above-ground cathodic protection survey of onshore high-pressure gas pipeline network. Close-interval potential survey across 480km of pipeline.

title: Training Services — Workplace Safety Modules
description: Development and delivery of workplace safety training modules for resources sector workers. Includes e-learning content and face-to-face delivery.

title: Integrated IRM Services — Multi-Asset Framework
description: Five-year integrated inspection, repair and maintenance services framework spanning multiple offshore production assets. Vendors must demonstrate full IRM capability including ROV, NDT, repair, and integrity reporting. Estimated annual call-off $8–15M.

title: Geotechnical Survey — Offshore Wind Site Assessment
description: Geotechnical and seabed survey services for proposed offshore wind site in Bass Strait. Includes CPT, borehole sampling, and seabed mapping.
